english_draft:
Samsung Electronics published its Q4 2025 results on January 29, 2026. Revenue for Q4 2025 was KRW 93.8 trillion. Revenue rose by 9% quarter on quarter. This was the highest quarterly revenue ever. Operating profit was KRW 20.1 trillion. This was the highest operating profit ever. Full-year revenue was KRW 333.6 trillion. Full-year operating profit was KRW 43.6 trillion.

The DS division reported Q4 revenue of KRW 44.0 trillion. DS operating profit was KRW 16.4 trillion. DS revenue rose 33% quarter on quarter. Memory revenue and operating profit reached record highs. Memory benefited from HBM sales, strong DRAM demand, and rising prices. System LSI profit declined because of seasonal softness and customer schedule changes. Image sensor revenue grew. Foundry revenue increased. Foundry profit improvement was limited by provisional costs. Foundry started mass production of first-generation 2nm products. Foundry shipped 4nm HBM base-die products.

SDC reported Q4 revenue of KRW 9.5 trillion. SDC operating profit was KRW 2.0 trillion. MX and Networks reported Q4 revenue of KRW 29.3 trillion. Their operating profit was KRW 1.9 trillion. MX smartphone sales declined in Q4. MX achieved double-digit annual profit in 2025. VD and DA reported Q4 revenue of KRW 14.8 trillion. Their operating loss was KRW 0.6 trillion. Harman reported Q4 revenue of KRW 4.6 trillion. Harman operating profit was KRW 0.3 trillion.

The sum of the reported segment profits equals KRW 20.0 trillion. This is KRW 0.1 trillion lower than the consolidated profit. The official announcement does not explain this difference.

No same-period preview article was available. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare actual results with an earlier forecast. This analysis is based only on the official press release.

For Q1 2026, the company expects AI and server demand to increase. The Memory Business plans to deliver HBM4 products in Q1 2026. The Foundry Business expects revenue to decline sequentially because of seasonality. MX will launch the Galaxy S26 series. SDC expects weak smartphone demand.
reader_questions: 存储业务在2025Q4的具体利润贡献是多少？官方只给了整个DS分部16.4万亿韩元，而存储“创纪录”是核心叙事，但如果没有单独的存储利润数字，就无法判断存储是否承担了DS几乎全部利润，以及LSI和Foundry的实际盈亏程度。
“MX全年实现两位数利润”的具体口径是什么？是营业利润率还是利润增速？不同口径会显著改变对手机业务盈利趋势的判断。
合并营业利润20.1万亿韩元与分部利润加总20.0万亿韩元之间相差0.1万亿韩元，原因是什么？如果来自公司总部费用或内部抵消，分部盈利能力的横向比较可能需要重新校准。
fact_checks: 核对日期2026-01-29、季度2025Q4（截至2025-12-31）、币种KRW、单位万亿，均与原文一致。原文未标注GAAP/非GAAP，本稿不使用非GAAP口径。集团与分部数据已区分：合并、DS、SDC、MX/Networks、VD/DA、Harman。已核对：合并营收/营业利润、分部收入/营业利润、研发投入等全部引用数值与官方新闻稿原文一致。事实与公司指引已区分：业绩表现为事实，2026Q1及全年计划为公司指引。本稿推论：分部利润加总与合并利润因未公开差异存在0.1万亿差距，由计算得出。无同期Preview、无市场共识来源，故无预期差对比。
